use_cases.reason: Wallet-core has resumable issuance state, WUA binding, pre-authorized token request construction, injected token, credential, and deferred endpoint boundaries with opaque token handles, explicit token-exchange state, deferred response handling, and inventory validation. Concrete OpenID4VCI issuer and HTTP-adapter composition is exercised downstream by Identity Conformance.

Wallet-core has consent, RP registration certificate screening, batch-pool allocation, policy SatisfactionPlan derivation integration, zk fail-closed tests, and reference-run manifests for full OpenID4VP response evidence delegated to openid4vp and identity.
Bounded QR/link/contact delivery adapters are implemented and tested.
The sole WalletCoreService method carries the canonical WalletOperationRequest and WalletOperationResponse contract through strict generated codecs and the transport-neutral executor.
